title: Anthropic signs $9.1 billion data center deal with Riot Platforms
excerpt: The 20-year lease covers 191 megawatts of computing capacity at Riot's Rockdale, Texas, campus and runs through June 2048
content_html:
Anthropic has struck a $9.1 billion agreement with Riot Platforms, a bitcoin mining company that has been building out AI data center capacity, according to Bloomberg.

Riot disclosed the deal on Monday, describing the counterparty only as a "leading frontier AI lab." Riot's Rockdale, Texas, campus will supply 191 megawatts of IT capacity under the terms of the 20-year lease, which extends through June 2048, the company said. Two five-year extension options could raise the total contract value to $16.1 billion.

Riot plans to bring capacity online in stages, reaching 96 megawatts by December 2027 and completing the full 191-megawatt buildout by June 2028, the company said. To fund the project's early construction phase, Riot arranged a $573 million interim financing facility through Morgan Stanley as it works toward putting a permanent credit backstop in place.

Riot CEO Jason Les said in a statement that the two agreements together bring the company's total signed capacity to 241 megawatts and roughly $9.8 billion in long-term contracted revenue, all accumulated within six months. The earlier deal was with Advanced Micro Devices.

Riot stock closed down 5.46% on Monday before the deal was announced, then surged more than 25% in after-hours trading.

The Anthropic deal was announced alongside Riot's second-quarter financial results, which showed revenue growth alongside a wider net loss. Total revenue for the three months ended June 30 came in at $174.2 million, up 14% from $153 million a year earlier. Bitcoin mining contributed $113.7 million, while data center revenue was $23.2 million. That compares with net income of $219.5 million, or $0.58 per share, in the year-ago quarter; this quarter Riot swung to a net loss of $237.2 million, or $0.68 per diluted share.

Anthropic has been pursuing a series of large computing agreements as demand for its products grows. The company signed a $10 billion, six-year deal with Volta Infra Holdings, a months-old AI infrastructure startup backed by Nvidia, to use capacity at a data center in Norway. Anthropic also agreed to buy nearly $45 billion worth of computing from Elon Musk's xAI in May, according to Bloomberg. Earlier arrangements have included deals with SpaceX, AMD, and Akamai Technologies.

Riot's path to data centers is an unlikely one: the company spent years in biotech diagnostics under the Bioptix name before reinventing itself as a bitcoin miner, and it is now part of a broader wave of crypto companies chasing AI infrastructure revenue.

content_html_zh:
据彭博社报道，Anthropic 已与 Riot Platforms 达成了一项价值 91 亿美元的协议，Riot Platforms 是一家比特币挖矿公司，一直在建设人工智能数据中心容量。

Riot 周一披露了这笔交易，仅将交易对手描述为“领先的前沿人工智能实验室”。 Riot 表示，根据 20 年租约条款，Riot 位于德克萨斯州罗克代尔的园区将提供 191 兆瓦的 IT 容量，租期延长至 2048 年 6 月。 两个五年的延期选项可能会将合同总价值提高到 161 亿美元。

该公司表示，Riot 计划分阶段上线产能，到 2027 年 12 月达到 96 兆瓦，到 2028 年 6 月完成 191 兆瓦的全部建设。 为了为该项目的早期建设阶段提供资金，Riot 通过摩根士丹利安排了 5.73 亿美元的临时融资贷款，以建立永久性的信贷支持。

Riot首席执行官贾森·莱斯(Jason Les)在一份声明中表示，这两项协议使该公司的总签约容量达到241兆瓦，长期合同收入约为98亿美元，全部在六个月内累积。 早期的交易是与 Advanced Micro Devices 达成的。

Riot 股价周一在交易宣布前收盘下跌 5.46%，随后在盘后交易中飙升逾 25%。

Anthropic 交易是与 Riot 第二季度财务业绩一起宣布的，该业绩显示收入增长，但净亏损扩大。 截至 6 月 30 日的三个月总收入为 1.742 亿美元，比去年同期的 1.53 亿美元增长 14%。 比特币挖矿贡献了 1.137 亿美元，而数据中心收入为 2320 万美元。 相比之下，去年同期净利润为 2.195 亿美元，即每股 0.58 美元；本季度 Riot 净亏损 2.372 亿美元，即稀释后每股亏损 0.68 美元。

随着对其产品需求的增长，Anthropic 一直在寻求一系列大型计算协议。 该公司与 Volta Infra Holdings 签署了一项价值 100 亿美元、为期六年的协议，使用挪威数据中心的容量。Volta Infra Holdings 是一家成立数月的人工智能基础设施初创公司，由 Nvidia 支持。 据彭博社报道，5 月份，Anthropic 还同意从埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 xAI 购买价值近 450 亿美元的计算设备。 早期的安排包括与 SpaceX、AMD 和 Akamai Technologies 的交易。

Riot 通往数据中心的道路不太可能：该公司在将自己重塑为比特币矿工之前，以 Bioptix 的名义花了数年时间从事生物技术诊断，现在它是追逐人工智能基础设施收入的更广泛的加密货币公司浪潮的一部分。
